textRuns.value: Pre-trend check: weekly coefficients for weeks -7 through -1 sit close to 0 (parallel-trends holds), with one marginal point at week -8 noted as a caveat rather than smoothed away. Post-rebank weeks move further negative, consistent with the headline D0/A14 effect sizes at left -- DFW's reliability did not improve relative to ORD after the April 2026 rebank, net of weather. Taxi-out time effect is directionally favorable but not statistically significant. Method: two-way fixed-effects diff-in-diff, DFW vs ORD, weather-adjusted (signature analysis #2, analysis/dfw_rebank_event_study.py).
